note: Patcher matrix for B190, REBUILT FROM main AT d4215ca (PR #353) and published in place over the original B190 bundle (built from 94bcf83, PR #350). B190 exists for ONE defect: the spa lounger pose (#330). WHAT FIXED IT: the stock chaise dispatch at .text+0x37444 selects the BODY POSITION by orientation -- orientation 1 -> body 0x17 (chaise) + SleepNE, otherwise body 9 (resting hammock) + SleepNW. Every earlier round, including the first B190 build, hardcoded body 0x17 for BOTH orientations and then varied the direction, head or strip; a direction argument cannot correct a wrong body sprite. The spa loungers now use one body table (VF2PlanSpaLoungerPose, 3-argument PlanToWait, the hammock's shape) at every route; the spa treatment and the nap/sleep relax rolls settle through it and then play the strip, awake relax rolls hold it. The owner confirmed the pose in play on probe v10 (commit 2a0bbbb). ALSO: per-orientation walk-target nudges from the owner's screenshots (head-upper-right placement 4px left; head-upper-left placement net 2px left); the drop route uses the placement the engine linked, whole, and falls back to an ordinary relax if the shared-object link lands on an ordinary chaise; the autonomous spa treatment is offered only while a spa lounger is in the house; Home Gym and Yoga Mat autonomous workouts are gated on their object (PR #352). SUPERSEDED: the previous value of this field described the 'mirror' model (PR #350) and the 'opposite arms' model (PR #352) -- both kept body 0x17 on both orientations and both failed in play; their text is preserved in the History section of docs/B190-release-notes.md, which must not be allowed to disagree with this field. SEEDED FROM B189. Issue #330 closes when the owner confirms both loungers on the published bundle.
